title: BikeMaster Deluxe Helmet Stand
features: Heavy-duty steel construction for long-lasting durability
Adjustable height and angle to fit various helmet sizes
Non-slip rubber base prevents sliding on any surface
description:
Built to protect your helmet investment between epic journeys, the BikeMaster Deluxe Helmet Stand from BikeMaster delivers comprehensive hygiene, drying, and surface protection. Built with Fleece-Padded Protective Enclosure Shielding Against Scratches and UV, it boasts an installation rating of 1.0 / 10 (Direct wipe application or plug-and-play operation).

The BikeMaster Deluxe Helmet Stand from BikeMaster is a must-have maintenance asset for riders who value helmet longevity. It keeps premium EPS liners hygienic, odor-free, and protected between track days and long-haul expeditions.
